discovery_budget.discovery: Reuse keys must bind to a transfer fingerprint (origin account, beneficiary token, amount minor units) not a fresh UUID per HTTP attempt.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming fingerprint scope collapses diagnosis to a single map lookup fix.

discovery_budget.discovery: The reuse window anchors from first gateway-accepted submission timestamp, not from local key mint time.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating the anchor rule lets agents patch TTL without reading compendium precedence disputes.

discovery_budget.discovery: Retry-After may be delta-seconds or HTTP-date; the broken transport accepts only integer seconds.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing header duality reduces throttle tests to a one-line parser branch.

discovery_budget.discovery: Dispatch performs a probe POST then a commit POST in separate goroutine windows, re-minting keys between them under load.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Cause-revealing orchestration detail would steer agents away from vault/backoff coupling.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Instruction describes duplicate settlements, permanent throttle failures, and compendium divergence without section numbers, header algorithms, or file paths.

attack_path.summary: Agent adds sync.Mutex around UUID generator and a fixed sleep retry loop.
attack_path.reasoning: Passes solo lane but fails parallel duplicate, HTTP-date throttle, reuse-window expiry, and hidden burst scenarios.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Mutex vault lookup by fingerprint, parse Retry-After as RFC7231 date or seconds, collapse probe/commit to share vault slot.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Still requires reading three compendium chapters for fingerprint fields, TTL anchor, and date header worked example.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Editable frontier spans three Go packages plus scenario drivers; requirement map is many-to-many; oracle estimated 45+ LOC substantive edits.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: After files are visible, agent must still reconcile contradictory errata in volume 04 against meridian_precedence.md and wire HTTP-date example from chapter_rate_limits into backoff without instruction citing either.
